text: Dependency Analyzer scans the full repository tree (not just /src) for pom.xml, requirements.txt, package.json, and go.mod; writes empty artifacts and exits cleanly when none are found
Dependency Analyzer re-runs a full manifest scan every invocation regardless of prior empty results; new manifests added by other agents between runs will be picked up on the next fast-forward pull

OSV scanner stores Go module versions without the leading 'v' prefix (e.g. '1.6.3'), while go.mod and Trivy use 'v1.6.3' — normalize by stripping 'v' when cross-referencing OSV results for Go packages
The /src symlink is not present in this Reverse-Engineering agent environment; scanners must be invoked with the full absolute path to the repository src/ directory instead
